question_withdrawn.asked: Do you already have a GitHub connector enabled in your ChatGPT account?
question_withdrawn.why: OE-W7-CHATGPT-ROUTE-EVIDENCE established from live documentation that ChatGPT's supported connector list is exactly eight services and contains no GitHub connector. The thing I asked him to check does not exist, so no answer he could give would have been useful.
question_withdrawn.controller_error: I asked a question shaped by an assumption rather than by evidence. The route existed; the name did not. Asking about a mechanism before establishing that the mechanism exists wastes a founder action, which is the cost this programme is specifically supposed to avoid.

replacement_question.ask: Is Codex connected to GitHub in your ChatGPT account, and which repositories can it access?
replacement_question.why_this_is_the_right_question: Codex, signed in to his ChatGPT account, is the GitHub-reaching route. It is not called a connector, which is why the first question missed it.
replacement_question.leverage: HIGHEST among open questions. It decides whether the ChatGPT-to-Cursor loop can close today or needs building.

the_finding_that_changes_the_connection_.statement: Three routes close the ChatGPT-to-Cursor loop for one reason: they write where Cursor already reads. No conversation API does that; a commit does.

routes.name: Codex cloud with a connected GitHub repository
Codex code review on a pull request
routes.detail: posts a review on the pull request as a teammate would, automatically on every PR, and can push a fix back to the branch

routes.name: Codex GitHub Action (openai/codex-action@v1)
routes.detail: runs in this repository's own CI

the_finding_that_changes_the_connection_.consequence: The connection problem the advisory proposal left unsolved — how anything reaches Cursor without the founder carrying it — has an answer that does not require the founder to relay anything.

the_asymmetry_worth_recording.statement: Two agent platforms answer the same question oppositely.
the_asymmetry_worth_recording.cursor: The Cloud Agents API streams the agent's actual reply; the result event's text is the final assistant reply.
the_asymmetry_worth_recording.openai_workspace_agents: The documentation states the agent's response cannot currently be retrieved through the API. Beta polling returns queued, in_progress, suspended, completed or failed, and no content.
the_asymmetry_worth_recording.design_consequence: Any loop should terminate on the Cursor side. Workspace Agents has real value for dispatch and must never be drawn as a closed loop, because a workflow ending in the founder opening a conversation URL is founder-as-relay with automation upstream of the link he still has to open.

cross_check_performed_on_this_controller.concern: The predecessor harvest recorded a 404 for a Cursor API source, and the launch guide makes claims about the Cursor Agent API. If the guide had inherited a wrong path its blocker analysis would be wrong.
cross_check_performed_on_this_controller.checked: The guide's claims were read directly rather than assumed sound.
cross_check_performed_on_this_controller.result: NO CORRECTION NEEDED. The guide records 401 on the real endpoints /v1/me, /v1/agents, /v1/models and /v1/repositories, and a differently-shaped 404 on a nonexistent route, which is exactly right. The predecessor's 404 was on a documentation page URL, not an API endpoint. Two different things that happened to share a status code.

other_corrections_to_the_inherited_pictu.was: Cursor's inbound API documentation could not be located (404).
other_corrections_to_the_inherited_pictu.now: The 404 was a guessed path. Reading the published sitemap produced cloud-agent/api/endpoints and cloud-agent/api/webhooks, both 200.

other_corrections_to_the_inherited_pictu.was: A public HTTPS endpoint was identified as a blocker for connecting a private MCP server to ChatGPT.
other_corrections_to_the_inherited_pictu.now: Secure MCP Tunnel, absent from the harvest entirely, connects a private MCP server over an outbound-only connection from a host inside the network, removing that blocker. The remaining need is a durable host, which an ephemeral pod is not.
